canDoYue: 你能夠先聽完投訴，再道歉，然後提出修理、換貨或者退款。
canDoEn: Listen to a complaint, apologize, and offer a repair, a replacement, or a refund.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: I am sorry there is an issue, and I will listen before I offer a repair.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思有問題，我會先聽完先提出修理。
dialogue.say: I am sorry there is an issue, and I will listen before I offer a repair.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The clasp is broken, so I would like a repair or a full refund today.
dialogue.glossYue: 個扣壞咗，所以我今日想修理或者全數退款。
dialogue.say: The clasp is broken, so I would like a repair or a full refund today.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: I apologize for the inconvenience, and I understand why you feel disappointed today.
dialogue.glossYue: 造成不便我道歉，我明白你今日點解唔開心。
dialogue.say: I apologize for the inconvenience, and I understand why you feel disappointed today.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you replace the piece today, and tell me what you can do about it?
dialogue.glossYue: 今日可唔可以換過呢件，同我講你做到啲咩？
dialogue.say: Could you replace the piece today, and tell me what you can do about it?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: The manager can review the receipt, and we will repair it immediately if the policy allows.
dialogue.glossYue: 經理可以睇收據，如果政策容許，我哋會即刻修理。
dialogue.say: The manager can review the receipt, and we will repair it immediately if the policy allows.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I appreciate the offer, but I still want a refund if the repair cannot be done today.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝你嘅提議，但如果修理唔到，我今日仍然想退款。
dialogue.say: I appreciate the offer, but I still want a refund if the repair cannot be done today.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Would it help if we replace the bracelet today, while the workshop keeps the broken one?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我哋今日換過條手鏈，工場留住壞嗰條，會唔會好啲？
dialogue.say: Would it help if we replace the bracelet today, while the workshop keeps the broken one?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: I will write the complaint clearly, and you will have an update before the shop closes tonight.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會寫清楚投訴，舖頭今晚收之前話你知進展。
dialogue.say: I will write the complaint clearly, and you will have an update before the shop closes tonight.

Would it help if we replace it? 係？
understand.explain: Would it help if 係提議，唔係承諾一定得。

quiz.prompt: Listen to the clip once, then choose the word you heard for giving the money back.
Listen to the clip once, then choose the word you heard for fixing the clasp.
When a guest says "I have a complaint", what does complaint mean here?
When Mei says "we will repair it immediately", what does immediately mean?
Which of these counter words contains the /l/ sound: immediately, refund, or issue?

sound.title: 即刻入面嗰個音
sound.note: immediately 有 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面。repair 重音喺第二節。refund 名詞重音喺第一節。
